notes: Run each query with the X public read tool search_posts_all (namespace 'x'); save each raw result as data/raw/<topic>_<n>.txt, then: python3 xfeed_ingest.py data/raw/<topic>_*.txt
X search has no engagement filter: min_likes/min_retweets are stripped by the tool, so ranking/filtering by likes and followers happens in the UI.
9 reads per full refresh. Limits: 30/min, 1000/day shared with other X use. Hourly refresh = ~216/day; every 30 min = ~432/day.
start_time: use (now - 12h); for incremental runs you may use since_id = newest id per query instead (only one of start_time/since_id).
